findings.summary: Criterion 4 has 2 demonstrations; it needs exactly one
findings.evidence: Criterion 4 is: Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle` and `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test job_plan`. A producer report with no full-suite check, or with `not-run`, goes to the verifier without a send-back. A report with unmet criteria is still sent back once. A candidate whose recorded test check fails is still rejected.

summary: Athena's own checks found a major problem in the plan; the critic was not called.
